name: gemma4-e2b-agentic-qpu-up-overlap
objective: Reduce post-tool time to first token by computing a suffix of each Q4_0 ffn_up output on QPU0 while four CPU threads compute the remaining ffn_up columns and the independent ffn_gate projection.

candidate.integration_boundary: CPU_REPACK ffn_up launch through the split-F32 GEGLU join
candidate.strategy: QPU output-column suffix overlapped with the CPU output-column prefix and subsequent ffn_gate
candidate.weights: unpacked once from native Q4_0 into persistent DMA memory
candidate.activations: converted per invocation from CPU_REPACK Q8_0x4 into reusable cached DMA memory
candidate.output: copied from reusable cached DMA memory into only the QPU-owned F32 suffix
candidate.fallback: on completion failure, recompute the owned suffix from the persistent packed buffers on CPU before GEGLU

incremental_prefill.primary_metric: post-tool request time through first generated token

experimental_design.calibration: choose one QPU output fraction independently for each M using separate processes
experimental_design.heldout: evaluate only the selected fraction in fresh paired CPU/QPU sessions
experimental_design.pairing: identical model-visible token IDs, model, context, thread counts, and generation settings
experimental_design.ordering: randomize CPU and QPU process order within each independent pair
experimental_design.aggregation: reduce repeated requests within each process to one median before bootstrapping paired session speedups

required_qpu_telemetry: 35 weight-registration events with tensor, k, n, max_m, resident column range, and resident_bytes
